title: Tube along a path with rotation-minimizing frames
purpose: Sweep a circular tube along a polyline or a centripetal Catmull-Rom spline in three.js with rotation-minimizing frames, so the cross-section and its texture never spin at inflections; loops spread their twist evenly, radii vary per point and corners are mitred. Use it for cables, pipes, vines, rails and knots.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: sampleCentripetalCatmullRom, rotationMinimizingFrames and tubeRmfData need no three.js; createTubeRmfGeometry takes three.js as THREE; only 0.186.1 was run.

exports.name: tubeRmfData
exports.signature: tubeRmfData(points, options = {}) -> {positions, normals, uvs, indices, pathLength}
exports.summary: The tube as typed arrays, triangles counter-clockwise from outside, u along the path by arc length.

exports.name: createTubeRmfGeometry
exports.summary: The same data in a BufferGeometry with an index and computed bounds.

exports.name: sampleCentripetalCatmullRom
exports.signature: sampleCentripetalCatmullRom(points, samplesPerSegment = 8, closed = false) -> {points, tangents, segments, fractions}
exports.summary: Samples and unit tangents of the centripetal Catmull-Rom spline through the points.

exports.name: rotationMinimizingFrames
exports.summary: Double-reflection frames; options closed, correctTwist and initialNormal.

inputs.points: array of [x, y, z]; consecutive points distinct; a closed path does not repeat its first point

options.name: radius
options.meaning: Tube radius when radii is null.

options.name: radii
options.meaning: One radius per input point, interpolated along the path.

options.name: curve
options.meaning: Centripetal spline through the points, or straight segments with mitred corners.

options.name: caps
options.meaning: Flat caps on the ends of an open tube.

options.name: correctTwist
options.meaning: Spread a loop's leftover twist evenly so the seam closes.

options.name: initialNormal
options.meaning: Direction of the first frame's normal; null picks the axis least aligned with the first tangent.

limits: Frames are rotation-minimizing only between samples (the double reflection method is a fourth-order approximation), so sparse sampling of tight curves still drifts a little. Spline samples are equally spaced in the curve parameter, not in arc length, so rings bunch where points are close. Polyline corners are mitred for straight runs; a corner sharper than about 170 degrees is capped at a 20 times stretch and pinches. The tube does not detect self-intersection where the path bends tighter than the radius. Radii vary linearly between points and normals tilt with that slope. Only three.js 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Rotation-minimizing frames by double reflection (Wang, Juttler, Zheng and Liu)
Centripetal Catmull-Rom spline through the Barry and Goldman pyramid
Even distribution of a closed loop's holonomy angle
Mitre stretch by 1 / cos of the half turn
